NeoRuneExtended - C# mods for Minecraft Dungeons II

Usage: neorunex <command> [options]   (arguments can also come from @file.rsp)

  build      Compile a mod's C# sources to Blueprint packages and pack them.
               --mod <Name> --out <dir> --source <file.cs>... --ref <file.dll>...
               [--install] [--game <game folder>] [--tools <dir with retoc/repak>]
               [--title <name>] [--version <x.y>] [--author <name>] [--author-url <url>]
               [--description <text>]   (the Mods tab of Blueprint Loader 2.0)
  install    Copy a built mod into the game's ~mods folder (skips unchanged files).
               --mod <Name> --pak <dir with Name_P.*> [--game <game folder>]
               [--bindings <NeoRune.Game.json>]  (warns NR0003 if the game is another build)
  doctor     Check the setup: game folders, mod loader, installed mods, and the game build
             against your NeoRuneExtended.Sdk versions. Run it in a mod folder to also check that mod.
               [--game <game folder>] [--project <mod folder or .csproj>]
  discover   Dump the running game's reflected API (read-only memory access).
               [--out <api.json.gz>]
  bindings   Generate the C# bindings project from an API dump.
               --api <api.json[.gz]> --out <dir> --abstractions <NeoRuneExtended.Abstractions.csproj>
  diff       Report API changes between two dumps (run after a game patch).
               <old.json.gz> <new.json.gz>
  log        Print what a mod wrote with NeoRune.Log.
               <ModName> | <file.sav>   [--follow]  (keep printing new lines while you play)
  disasm     Print the bytecode of a generated (or any versioned) Blueprint package.
               <file.uasset>
